name: @majlis/web
description: Majlis web client: Vite + React, generated from the contract, implementing docs/clients/NAVIGATION.md.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @majlis/contracts build && pnpm --filter @majlis/ui-tokens build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @majlis/contracts build && pnpm --filter @majlis/ui-tokens build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @majlis/contracts build && pnpm --filter @majlis/ui-tokens build && vitest run
